description_en: Deletes MCP Servers from a specified workspace
description_zh: 删除指定工作空间中的 MCP Server
name: DeleteDataAgentMcp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Agent workspace
parameters.help_zh: Data Agent 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The list of MCP Server IDs to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的 MCP Server ID 列表
parameters.name: mcp_server_ids

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the deletion status is updated. A value of true indicates that at least one matching record has been logically deleted
Data.description_zh: 是否成功更新删除状态。true 表示至少一条匹配记录已完成逻辑删除

ErrorCode.description_en: The return code. The value success is returned for a successful request. An error code is returned for a failed request
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功时为 success；请求失败时为对应的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when a system-level request failure occurs
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 系统级请求失败时返回的错误信息

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. A value of true indicates success. A value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求处理是否成功。取值为 true 表示成功，取值为 false 表示失败
